blocks.html: Marlin fishing in cabo | world-class striped, blue & black marlin charters

Experience the excitement of marlin fishing in Cabo with Exotic Fish Cabo.

Los Cabos is internationally known for its striped marlin, blue marlin, and black marlin fishing opportunities. Our private marlin fishing charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, offering access to offshore fishing grounds in the Sea of Cortez.

Whether you're visiting Cabo San Lucas or staying in San José del Cabo, our experienced local captains can help you plan a marlin fishing adventure based on seasonal activity and ocean conditions.

Choose from private 6-hour and 8-hour sportfishing trips and discover why marlin fishing is one of Cabo's most sought-after experiences.

MARLIN CATCHES

Cabo San Lucas is one of the world’s top destinations for marlin fishing.

Known as the “Marlin Capital of the World,” this stunning point where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez offers ideal conditions for anglers in search of a true deep-sea challenge. Whether you’re an experienced angler or a first-timer, marlin fishing in Cabo promises an unforgettable offshore adventure.

OUR MARLIN FISHING CHARTERS

Our private marlin fishing charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, providing access to offshore fishing grounds in the Sea of Cortez. Our experienced local crews adapt fishing techniques and locations to seasonal activity, ocean conditions, and the preferences of each group. Anglers may encounter three main marlin species in the region: striped marlin, blue marlin, and black marlin.

BEST SEASON FOR MARLIN FISHING IN CABO

Striped marlin are commonly targeted during the cooler months, particularly from November through spring. Blue marlin and black marlin are generally associated with warmer water conditions, with opportunities often improving during summer and fall. Actual fishing activity varies from year to year depending on water temperatures, currents, and baitfish availability.

Los Cabos offers marlin fishing opportunities throughout the year, although no particular species or catch can be guaranteed.

BOOK YOUR MARLIN FISHING TRIP

Planning your Cabo marlin fishing adventure is easy with Exotic Fish Cabo. Choose from private 6-hour and 8-hour fishing charters departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

Each private charter includes an experienced local crew, fishing rods, reels, basic tackle, bottled water, and soft drinks. Fishing licenses, bait, meals, transportation, and fish-cleaning services should be confirmed before booking.

Our goal is to deliver more than just a fishing trip — an unforgettable experience on the waters of Los Cabos.

If you're ready for an exciting big game fishing adventure, Cabo marlin fishing offers the opportunity to encounter some of the ocean's most impressive game fish.

Come chase the fish of a lifetime in the beautiful offshore waters of Baja California Sur with Exotic Fish Cabo.
